label: Cattle identification and traceability
description: Cattle, bovines, cows, calves, and bison identification using ear tags, RFID tags, passports, and digital movement records. Covers traceability, movement reporting, welfare, trade assurance, farm compliance, and disease control including bovine tuberculosis (bTB), Bluetongue, and Foot and Mouth Disease.
